source.headline: The 10-year Treasury is closing in on 5%. How it gets there matters more

DXY.source: Reuters Monday dollar report plus latest available DXY quote snapshot

US10Y.source: Forex Factory/CNBC story and Sunday-Monday market reporting

VIX.source: latest U.S. cash-session VIX close available before prediction

learning_profile.note: Current macro facts support a bearish rates-sensitive equity signal, but ACTIONABLE v2 directional confidence calibration for model 1.1.1 argues against stronger confidence, so confidence is capped rather than the direction being changed.

predictions.mechanism: A 10-year Treasury yield near 5%, combined with renewed oil-driven inflation pressure and rising Fed hike odds, raises the discount rate applied to long-duration growth equities.
predictions.invalidation: US10Y falls materially away from 5% and oil/rate-hike expectations ease while Nasdaq futures recover.

predictions.mechanism: Near-5% long yields tighten financial conditions and pressure equity valuation multiples while elevated crude keeps inflation risk high.
predictions.invalidation: A clear retreat in Treasury yields and crude prices restores a risk-on backdrop.

predictions.mechanism: Higher long-term borrowing costs and inflation pressure are negative for cyclicals, though the Dow is less duration-sensitive than Nasdaq.
predictions.invalidation: US10Y retreats and economically sensitive sectors strengthen despite the rates backdrop.

predictions.mechanism: Rising real/nominal yields and higher Fed hike expectations are a direct headwind for non-yielding gold, partly offset by geopolitical demand.
predictions.invalidation: Safe-haven demand overwhelms the rates channel or Treasury yields reverse lower sharply.
